From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Stakeholder mapping & procurement next steps - Aurora Retail

Hi Emily / Alex —

Thanks again for the time on today's call. Quick recap + next steps so we have alignment: 

Call highlights
- Use case: customer support automation + smart routing for returns (pilot: 10k interactions/month).
- Key constraints: 99th pct latency target < 200ms for chat flow, PCI-like data handling, on-prem option for PII workflows.

Open items we discussed (asking for your help)
1) Stakeholder map: could you share an org chart or list of decision makers (economic buyer, procurement, security lead, integration owner)?
2) Procurement steps: primary PO process, typical timeline, any standard contractual requirements (PO, SOW, security addendum).
3) Security/Compliance: who owns questionnaires (SOC2/ISO) and where should we route the security artifact packet?
4) Decision criteria: what are the top 3 must-haves for Aurora to sign a pilot?

Action items from Redwood
- I'll send a short stakeholder mapping template (attached) — if you can fill and return, we can prepare a tailored mutual action plan.
- We'll prep a short procurement cover note you can forward to your procurement team.

Proposed next step
- If you can share the stakeholder list + procurement contact this week, I can assemble a two-week pilot plan and calendar a 30-min follow-up next Tue/Wed.

Attaching: redwood-stakeholder-template.xlsx (stakeholder mapping template)

Thanks — looking forward to continuing the momentum.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Thanks Marissa — great summary. A few quick notes: 

We can share an initial org chart and contact list. Preliminary info below (I'll attach a PDF with the visual org chart):
- Economic buyer: Alex Park (VP Product) — alex.park@aurora-retail.com
- Procurement contact: Priya Natarajan — procurement@aurora-retail.com (handles SOWs and PO)
- Security lead: Kevin Liu — kevin.liu@aurora-retail.com (owns questionnaire + pen tests)
- Integration/Platform owner: Daniel Cho (platform) — I will confirm email tomorrow.

Procurement process: we typically require a signed SOW + PO for pilots > $50k; the legal review usually takes 7–10 business days once the SOW is accepted. Security reviews (SOC2) are run in parallel but Kevin often requests a brief technical call.

I'll attach the org chart (aurora-org-chart.pdf) and will check with Priya about the right person to triage security docs. Could you also send a short procurement cover note and an email template we can forward to Priya?

Best,
Emily

Hi Emily — thanks for the quick turnaround and the contacts. Helpful. 

I've attached two files for you to forward to Priya and Kevin:
- redwood-stakeholder-template.xlsx (fill this with names, roles, ownership + expected decision timeline)
- procurement-cover-note.txt (short note you can forward to procurement to summarize pilot scope & budget band)

Suggested cover note (feel free to paste):
---
Hi Priya —

Following our discovery with Aurora's product team, Redwood would like to run a time-boxed pilot to validate: customer support automation and returns routing. Pilot scope: up to 10k interactions/month, integration via standard REST/webhooks, expected runtime 6 weeks. Estimated pilot cost band: $25k–$60k depending on optional on-prem requirement.

Attached: stakeholder mapping + short security packet. Marissa Cole (Redwood) is available to answer any procurement questions — marissa.cole@redwood.ai.
---

Decision criteria — examples to capture in the stakeholder template (so we can score fit):
- Integrations: API compatibility + timeline to production (weeks)
- Performance: 99th pct latency target and SLA expectations
- Data handling: ability to isolate PII pipelines/offload to private deployment
- Commercial: pilot scope and budget approvals

Next steps: can you: 1) fill the stakeholder template and return by EOD Wed (18 Nov), 2) loop in Priya and Kevin on a short intro so we can route security artifacts and procurement questions? If you prefer, I can draft the intro email for you to forward.

Attachments: redwood-stakeholder-template.xlsx, procurement-cover-note.txt

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call with Priya & Kevin to walk through the packet.

Best,
Marissa
